Create a box; --size small (2 vCPU, 8 GB), medium (4, 16) or large (4, 32), else your default size; --disk 50 to 300 GB, else 120; --minimal for the lean image; --no-setup to turn termag setup off.

Usage: termag box create <name> [--size small|medium|large] [--disk <GB>] [--from <github-url>] [--setup|--no-setup] [--wait] [--timeout <seconds>] [--if-not-exists] [--for-ask] [--minimal]

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
